findings.finding: Harris County (48201) has no theta_lo (0.2) qualifying event in its 2014-2022 training years, which is why the historical-mean baseline predicts 0 for it. The feed has usable Harris data in 5 fitted training years, and in none of them does the share stay at or above 0.2 for 4 continuous hours; the closest is 2021 (2.75 h).
